fusions.name: Cloudburst Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thunderhead
fusions.desc: Crashes down on the target for 30 damage, ignoring its resistances, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Washing Downpour
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you and every ally within 4.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Washed Clean
fusions.desc: When a condition on you ends, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
